segments.text: A male student who is part of the student council. He is childhood friends with Mia and Sumire. He is also kouhai to Renge who is also a part of the student council.
Mia tells Yugo that he has lost part of his memories due to a shock caused by an incident in the past.

He is a good-natured and serious person. He is compassionate and because of this, he is easily swayed and indecisive. It becomes even worse in terms of love. He is at the mercy of Mia and the others strong affections for him.
A female classmate living next door to Yuugo, she is his childhood friend who takes care of his needs on behalf of his parents who live abroad.
She has a kind and ladylike personality, and a homely side that excels at cooking and sewing.
She is popular among male students due to her feminine and family-oriented personality.

She regularly ranks high in the "unofficial ranking of girls I want as my future wife" and "ranking of girls who would be most devoted to you". Because of this, Yuugo is the constant target of envy and jealousy of others because of knowing her for so long.

Although she has a sights solely on Yuugo, she has not been able take the first step. She is shy about romance and has yet to establish a relationship that goes beyond being family. But because they have been together for so long, she thinks that it is natural that they should be together.
With the arrival of Sumire, who claims to also be Yuugo's childhood friend, her feelings for him start to run wild.

A beautiful young student who transferred from Florence, Italy to Yuugo's school. With blonde hair, blue eyes, and a lovely figure to match her style she is always scouted as a model when out on the town.

She is Yuugo's first childhood friend. Born in the same hospital at the same time, they became friends through their parents. When young, they played together in a nearby park, took baths together and shared their first kiss with each other.

She's been separated from Yuugo due to moving to Italy because of her parents own reasons but returns to Japan to fulfill their promise to meet each other again. To make up for lost time, she wants to be with Yuugo for as long as possible and that means being with him every minute.
Full of the passion she's cultivated in Italy, she's very aggressive in approaching Yuugo which results in a lot of skinship.
Yuugo's senpai and president of the Student council to which he also belongs. Brilliant and talented, she is a girl with excellent grades to match her good looks. She is highly trusted by teachers.
Growing up in a strict family, she struggles with expressing her emotions. Her blank expression makes people who come into contact with her for the first time feel that she is unapproachable.

Her cool appearance, earnest behavior and strict attitude give students the impression that she is overbearing. Moreover, students view her as the "model student" who is always one step ahead of everyone around her. Unbeknownst to her, this also results in hidden fans who can't get enough of her scornful eyes.
Her family runs a pharmaceutical company that further enhances her intellectual image. This leads others to nickname her the "Beauty of vials and test tubes'"
She has a strict attitude toward Yuugo because of her position as student council president and her strong sense of responsibility. Her true feelings however...
